c086.title: Taras learns karate
c086.story: Taras is Anna's little brother, and he starts [[karate]] this month. His [[dojo]] is near his school. His [[sensei]] has a black belt and a fifth [[dan]]. She also teaches [[kung fu]] on weekends. An older boy, Roman, is Taras's [[senpai]] and helps him with kicks. Every Friday, the kids do [[sparring]] in pairs. At home, Taras watches [[sumo]] on TV with Dad. One day, he meets a young [[gymnast]] from the next hall. She can do a perfect split, and Taras wants to try. Now he practices kicks and splits every day.

c087.title: Boxing night
c087.story: On Saturday night, Max invites his friends over to watch sports on TV. First they see a famous [[boxer]] win easily, and then the [[MMA]] event begins. The young [[challenger]] is clearly the [[underdog]], and nobody expects him to win. The main [[fight]] starts badly for him, and he falls in the first round. But this [[fighter]] does not give up, and slowly he makes a [[comeback]]. In the third round, he hits the [[champ]] hard and wins by [[knockout]]. The [[commentator]] screams, "We have a new [[champion]]!" and Max's cat hides. The fans in the hall are in total [[euphoria]], and so are Max's friends. Later, they watch the [[highlights|highlight]] again and again until midnight. Max says, "Tomorrow I'm going to the gym!"

c089.title: A day at the sea
c089.story: Max and Anna spend their summer vacation by the [[ocean]]. On the first day, they try [[surfing]] and [[SUP]]. A friendly [[surfer]] shows them his light [[fiberglass]] [[surfboard]]. Then they rent a [[kayak]] for two hours. The next morning, they go [[diving]] with a [[diver]] named Oleh. From the water, they see a small boat near the shore. Its [[keel]] hits a [[buoy]], but nobody is hurt. Above the beach, people are [[skydiving]] with colorful parachutes. In the evening, they race in a [[canoe]] along the shore. Anna wins, and Max says she is just lucky. Tired and happy, they eat ice cream and watch the sunset.

c092.title: Golf with Uncle Victor
c092.story: Max's rich uncle Victor invites him to his [[golf club]] on Sunday. Max has never played [[golf]], so he feels a little nervous. A friendly [[caddie]] carries their heavy bags across the green grass. While they walk, Uncle Victor talks about [[tennis]] and his trip to a [[grand slam]] final. He also loves [[polo]], [[rugby]] and especially [[cricket]]. He explains that in that game a [[bowler]] throws the ball at the wickets. Max tries his first shot, but the ball flies straight into the lake. Everyone laughs, including Max himself. On the way home, Max says, "Next time, let's just play [[badminton]] in the yard." Uncle Victor smiles and says, "Or [[ping-pong]] in my basement, or [[volleyball]] on the beach."

c093.title: Max's band
c093.story: Max loves rock, and he plays [[bass]] in a [[band]] with friends. This month, they want to try heavy metal. Every evening, they practice in Max's garage. The [[drummer]], Ihor, keeps a fast [[rhythm]]. The [[guitarist]], Sofia, tunes her [[instrument]] very carefully. Their [[frontman]], Dima, talks to the crowd at every show. As the [[vocalist]], he cannot find the right [[tone]] for one song. He tries again and again, and finally it sounds great. On Sunday, they record their first [[demo]] on a phone. Max sends it to Anna, and she says it's loud but cool.
